answer: In this PoA design, each identity must continuously complete a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, where every output feeds the next, while a Wesolowski proof attests correct evaluation. GPUs can run separate chains, but cannot shorten one chain through parallelism; creating clones therefore multiplies sequential time and resources. Whether hidden in a pearl, haven, or glacier, forged identities cannot evade this physical bottleneck, yielding Sybil resistance.
